description: Evacuate the most exposed groups first, use shelter for the high village, and dedicate late resources to the ferry connection: the orchard crosses before the lava, a skiff takes the research group from its dock before their terraces burn, a second skiff ferries the waterfront while the north generator (behind the barrier) powers the ferry terminal; the drainage is left unpumped, so the causeway drowns but the high lagoon fills; the high village waits in the quay shelter through the staging heat and leaves by skiff across the lagoon; the harbour mouth is cooled in the last window for the final ferry route. Step t=10400 repeats the last cooling for the Relaxed clock.
